hint.text: A pun is a play on words that creates a joke. Puns can make jokes by using words with multiple meanings or using words that sound alike but have different meanings.

instruction.text: Select the word which has a double meaning in the pun below.

atoms.b: The bicycle can’t stand on its own because it’s ((two-tyred.))

instruction.text: Select the word which has a double meaning in the pun below.

atoms.b: Why are teddy bears never hungry? Because they’re always ((stuffed))!

instruction.text: Select the word which has a double meaning in the pun below.

atoms.b: What did the cupcake say to the icing? I’d be ((muffin)) without you!

instruction.text: Select the word which has a double meaning in the pun below.

atoms.b: I wish I could be a doctor, but I don’t have the ((patients)).

instruction.text: Choose the word that best completes the pun.

atoms.b: His cat sits near the computer to keep an eye on the ((keyboard ++mouse screen)).
Crabs don’t like to share because they are ((++shellfish generous mean)).
Eating a hard-boiled egg for breakfast is hard to ((++beat do eat)).
The library is the tallest building in the whole city. It has so many ((++stories floors books)).
Ms Frog usually takes the underground, because her car was ((++toad old stolen)).

instruction.text: Are these sentences puns or adages? Drag each box into its correct category.

atoms.b: Why did the banana go to the doctor? He wasn’t peeling well.
I bought a boat because it was for sail.
Whoever invented zero, thanks for nothing.
Don’t judge a book by its cover.
